verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an availability and pricing check across hundreds of TLDs that needs no authentication. That covers the instant-availability and multi-TLD parts of the story, and one community comment praises a fast-loading UI. There is no evidence of active alternate-TLD suggestions and no stated policy or proof against lookup-then-squat front-running. Missing for 10: documented alternate-TLD suggestion feature, explicit no-front-running commitment or independent verification, hands-on evidence of search speed.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
the minimalist UI that actually loads fast was a breath of fresh air
